name: Mine Gatehouse v1 — Live passage vs Tutorial Island mining reference
right_label: CRAFTED REALM LIVE GAME, ROOF CUT AWAY
subtitle: Cobbled gate passage with portcullis and brazier, arch to the winch house, head-frame over the open cavern shaft
review_note: With the roof cut away the road reads as a road: cobbles run from the open gate to the road door, the tally board and brazier give the passage a job, and the arch frames the winch house where the head-frame stands over the cavern's own ladder hole. Scale beside the player is right. Held below 9.0: the cobble grid is regular, the head-frame is dark timber against a dark floor and needs a lit lamp cluster, and the ore bay is only glimpsed from this camera.
improve: Light the shaft with two hanging lamps, vary cobble sizes and add a worn wheel rut, and pull the ore bin forward to the bay mouth.
